name: GRouNdGAN
simulation_summary: Reference-based causal GAN simulator for single-cell RNA-seq data with an imposed global causal GRN and optional in silico TF perturbation experiments.

conditional_required.usage: Wrapper reads AnnData var_names as the public gene universe, model/checkpoint gene order and fixed output gene count.
conditional_required.message: Custom GroundGAN bundles require a reference h5ad whose var_names match the supplied causal graph and checkpoints.

conditional_required.usage: Wrapper passes this native GRouNdGAN causal graph pickle to the public CausalGANFactory and maps graph indices through reference AnnData var_names for truth/networks.csv.
conditional_required.message: Custom GroundGAN bundles require a causal graph pickle compatible with the reference h5ad gene order.

conditional_required.usage: Wrapper passes this trained GRouNdGAN model checkpoint to CausalGAN.generate_cells().
conditional_required.message: Custom GroundGAN bundles require a trained causal-GAN model checkpoint.

conditional_required.usage: Wrapper stages this causal-controller checkpoint at the path expected by upstream CausalGANFactory.
conditional_required.message: Custom GroundGAN bundles require the causal-controller checkpoint corresponding to the model checkpoint.

compatibility_rules.message: perturbation.tf_targets must be non-empty when perturbation.target_source=explicit_list.

threading.upstream_mapping: The wrapper sets torch.set_num_threads(runtime_resources.threads) and numeric-library CPU thread environment variables such as OMP_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS and NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS before invoking the public GRouNdGAN Python API. Upstream exposes no explicit CLI --threads or DataLoader worker option for generation.

input_bundle.description: Input bundle used for checkpoint inference. toy_* options use demo bundles embedded in the Docker image; custom_files requires the four GroundGAN bundle input files.

run_command.description: Scenario-controlled upstream operation. Capabilities lock this value so users cannot switch the selected experimental design from run parameters.

generation.description: Controls the number of generated single-cell columns.

num_cells.description: Number of cells generated for observational runs and matched control/perturbed pairs generated for perturbational runs.

preprocessing.description: Reference normalization setting required to instantiate the supplied checkpoint.

library_size.description: Maps to upstream [Preprocessing]/library size and must be compatible with the supplied checkpoint.

perturbation.description: Controls upstream perturbation mode for perturbational capabilities.

target_source.description: Selects perturbation TF targets. first_regulators chooses the first regulator in the imposed causal graph; explicit_list uses perturbation.tf_targets.

tf_targets.description: TF gene identifiers to perturb when target_source=explicit_list.

items.description: One TF gene identifier present in the reference and causal graph regulator set.

perturbation_values.description: Replacement TF expression values used in upstream perturbation mode. One value applies to all targets; otherwise provide one value per target.

parameter_bindings.description: Observational single-cell capabilities use the public CausalGAN.generate_cells() path.
Perturbation controls are hidden for observational runs because they are only used by the perturbational capability.

upstream_configuration: [Data]/causal graph points to a GRouNdGAN causal graph pickle
[EXPERIMENT]/checkpoint points to the trained GRouNdGAN model checkpoint
truth_contexts.generation: The wrapper maps each target/regulator index in the imposed causal graph through reference AnnData var_names and emits one truth/networks.csv row per TF-target edge with context=global.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: score is 1.0 because the native causal graph stores topology only; sign is '?' because GRouNdGAN does not encode activation or repression sign in causal_graph.pkl.
limitations: The imposed GRN is global for the whole generated dataset.
Checkpoint, causal graph and reference gene order must match exactly.

truth_contexts.explanation: A single GRouNdGAN run does not emit group-specific GRNs; duplicating the global GRN for generated clusters would be misleading.
GRouNdGAN does not emit cell-specific GRNs; cell-specific networks discussed in the publication are outputs of benchmarked inference tools, not simulator truth.

derivations.method: Write every normalized expression gene identifier to extras/enrichment_background.txt, one gene per line.
assumptions: The generated expression gene universe is the appropriate synthetic background for downstream analyses.
limitations: No external organism-specific enrichment universe is simulated.

derivations.method: Export the same global imposed causal graph used for truth as extras/prior_grn.tsv with score=1.0.
assumptions: The imposed causal graph can serve as an oracle prior only when explicitly requested.
limitations: This is truth-derived, not an independent noisy prior.

derivations.method: Write unique regulator IDs from the imposed causal graph to extras/tf_list.txt, one gene per line.
assumptions: Regulator indices in the imposed causal graph define the simulated TF universe.
limitations: The TF list is simulator-derived and may be narrower than an organism-wide TF catalogue.

native_outputs.description: Generated AnnData matrix written by the wrapper from public upstream CausalGAN.generate_cells() output.
Native GRouNdGAN causal_graph.pkl used to impose the global GRN.

artifacts_aux.description: Resolved upstream configparser INI file used for the run.
Pinned git commit, Python version, dependency versions and runtime resource mapping.
Mapping from native causal graph index identifiers to normalized public IDs.

parameter_bindings.description: Perturbational single-cell capabilities use upstream CausalGAN perturbation mode with frozen TF expression and noise.

upstream_configuration: [Perturbation]/tfs to perturb and [Perturbation]/perturbation values define intervention columns
Upstream perturbation mode uses frozen TF expressions, noise vectors and LSN state
truth_contexts.generation: The wrapper maps the imposed causal graph through reference AnnData var_names and emits one truth/networks.csv row per TF-target edge with context=global for both control and perturbed generated cells.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: score is 1.0 because the native causal graph stores topology only; sign is '?' because GRouNdGAN does not encode activation or repression sign in causal_graph.pkl.
limitations: The public GRN is fixed across control and perturbed cells.
Perturbations change generated expression values but do not rewire the imposed truth graph.
Perturbation targets must be TFs present in the dataset and causal graph regulator set.

truth_contexts.explanation: GRouNdGAN perturbation runs do not emit group-specific regulatory networks.
GRouNdGAN perturbation runs do not emit cell-specific regulatory networks.

derivations.method: Write one row per normalized expression column. Control columns receive no direct intervention; perturbed columns receive the configured TF target/value intervention and retain matched_pair_id linking to their control generated cell.
assumptions: Upstream perturbation mode generates before and after matrices from the same deterministic batch, so columns can be paired by native row order.
limitations: The perturbation design describes direct TF replacement values, not downstream causal effect sizes.

derivations.method: Collapse the configured TF replacement value from perturbation_design into extras/interventions.tsv.
assumptions: Columns with the same TF target and replacement value represent one intervention class.
limitations: GRouNdGAN supports setting TF expression values, not typed biological perturbation categories beyond wrapper labels such as knockout when value=0.

derivations.method: Write every normalized expression gene identifier to extras/enrichment_background.txt, one gene per line.
assumptions: The generated expression gene universe is the appropriate synthetic background for downstream analyses.
limitations: No external organism-specific enrichment universe is simulated.

derivations.method: Export the same global imposed causal graph used for truth as extras/prior_grn.tsv with score=1.0.
assumptions: The imposed causal graph can serve as an oracle prior only when explicitly requested.
limitations: This is truth-derived, not an independent noisy prior.

derivations.method: Write unique regulator IDs from the imposed causal graph to extras/tf_list.txt, one gene per line.
assumptions: Regulator indices in the imposed causal graph define the simulated TF universe.
limitations: The TF list is simulator-derived and may be narrower than an organism-wide TF catalogue.
